name: Black 11
description: Black 11, also known as Black-11, was the designation of a TIE/ln starfighter in the Imperial Black Squadron which was assigned to the Imperial Star Destroyer Steel Talon above the prison planet Despayre prior to the Battle of Yavin. Frequently used by Alpha Squadron's Lieutenant Commander Villian Dance, it was used by Dance to pursue and destroy the Lambda-class T-4a shuttle RLH-1 when the shuttle attempted to escape Despayre. By 4 ABY, Black 11 was operated by a TIE pilot nicknamed "Wampa," and stationed aboard the Super Star Destroyer Executor. At that time, Black 11 frequently served as an escort to the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader's shuttle, the Lambda-class T-4a shuttle ST 321.
